{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki> I spent two years in the Stromma diplomatic enclave at the edge of the Black City. I like these people, and I don't want to see them destroyed. ''[&hellip;]'' If Nuso Esva isn't stopped, it's the only possible outcome. ''[&hellip;]'' If he succeeds in holding the Red City, it'll be only a matter of time before he also takes the White City, then the Black City, and then the entire planet.|Stromma contingent stormtrooper Lhagva|<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />}}
Located on the<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} — Based on corresponding data for [[Quethold system/Legends|Quethold system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quethold]], the '''Black City''' was one of the three [[City/Legends|cities]] inhabited intermittently by the [[Quesoth]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Ruled by the Quesoth [[Queen of the Black]], the Black City contained the [[Stromma diplomatic enclave]], situated at the city's edge, where the [[Empire of the Hand]] [[Stromma contingent]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Lhagva]] stayed for two [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. After the inhabitants of Quethold's [[Red City]] arrived at the [[White City]], they stayed there for eighteen years before traveling to the Black City, where they would remain until the Queen of the Black died.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">The events of ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'' take place in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''.</ref> stormtrooper Lhagva wished to [[Attack on the Red City|free]] the Red City from [[Storm-hair|alien]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]]'s control, and when [[Stromma Council Liaison]] withdrew all Stromma from Imperial service, he refused to do so, as he liked the Quesoth, remarking his stay at the Black City.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />
